metadata.title: Implement Email Delivery with Reset Link

story.iWant: send password reset emails with secure links
story.soThat: users can complete the password reset flow
story.tasks: - Install and configure Nodemailer package - Create EmailService class for sending emails - Add environment variables for SMTP configuration - Design professional HTML email template - Implement password reset email sending logic - Add error handling for email delivery failures - Integrate email service into forgot-password endpoint - Test email delivery in development - Write unit tests for email service

story-context.acceptanceCriteria:
### AC1: Nodemailer Configured with Gmail SMTP - Nodemailer package installed and configured - SMTP transport configured with Gmail settings - Email service integrated into forgot-password flow
### AC2: Environment Variables for Email Service - SMTP_EMAIL environment variable for sender email - SMTP_PASSWORD environment variable for app-specific password - FRONTEND_URL environment variable for reset link base URL - Variables documented in .env.example
### AC3: Professional Email Template with Reset Link - Subject: "Password Reset Request" - Clear explanation of why user received email - Prominent reset button with clickable link - Plain text link as fallback - 1-hour expiration warning - Security note: "If you didn't request this, ignore it" - Branded sender: "Smart Budget App"
### AC4: Reset Link Format - Format: {FRONTEND_URL}/reset-password?token={JWT} - Example: http://localhost:3000/reset-password?token=eyJhbGci... - Token included as URL query parameter
### AC5: Email Delivery Error Handling - Email failures logged to console/logs - Errors don't expose to user (maintain security) - Still return success response to prevent email enumeration - Consider retry logic for transient failures

doc.title: Epic 11: Password Recovery & Account Security
doc.snippet: Send emails via Nodemailer with Gmail SMTP. Use app-specific password for Gmail. Reset links format: /reset-password?token=JWT. Email is part of password reset flow after token generation.

doc.title: Smart Budget App Architecture
doc.snippet: Environment variables managed via dotenv package. Configuration centralized in config/env.ts. All secrets stored in .env file (not committed to repo).

artifact.reason: Forgot password endpoint where email service will be integrated. After token generation, should trigger email sending.
Centralized configuration pattern. Add SMTP config here following existing pattern for database and JWT configs.
Standard response utilities. Use for consistent error handling in email service.

story-context.constraints: - Use Gmail SMTP with app-specific password (not regular password) - Store all email credentials in environment variables - Never expose email delivery errors to end users (security) - Always return success response even if email fails (prevent enumeration) - Log email failures for debugging but don't crash application - HTML email template must use inline CSS (better email client compatibility) - Include both HTML and plain text versions of email - Reset link must use FRONTEND_URL environment variable - Email must clearly state 1-hour expiration time - Future production: Consider SendGrid, AWS SES, or other providers - Development testing: Consider Mailtrap or similar

interface.name: EmailService.sendPasswordReset
interface.signature:
async sendPasswordReset(to: string, resetToken: string): Promise<void>
Parameters: - to: User's email address - resetToken: JWT token for password reset
Throws: - Error if email configuration is missing - Error if email send fails (caught and logged, not propagated)

interface.name: Email Template Structure
interface.signature:
Subject: Password Reset Request
HTML Body: - Header: "Smart Budget App" - Greeting: "Hello," - Explanation paragraph - Reset button (CTA) - Plain text link fallback - Expiration notice: "This link expires in 1 hour" - Security notice: "If you didn't request this, ignore it" - Footer
Plain Text Body: - Same content as HTML but text-only format

tests.standards: Project uses integration-style tests with real dependencies. For email testing: - Mock nodemailer transport for unit tests - Verify email content, recipients, subject - Test error handling when SMTP fails - Integration tests may use Mailtrap or similar test email service - Test files co-located with implementation
tests.ideas:
- Test EmailService initializes with correct SMTP config - Test transport creation with Gmail SMTP settings - Test service throws error if environment variables missing
- Test reads SMTP_EMAIL from environment - Test reads SMTP_PASSWORD from environment - Test reads FRONTEND_URL from environment - Test handles missing environment variables gracefully
- Test email subject is "Password Reset Request" - Test email includes reset link button - Test email includes plain text link - Test email mentions 1-hour expiration - Test email includes security notice - Test email sender is "Smart Budget App" - Test HTML version contains proper structure - Test plain text version is included
- Test reset link uses FRONTEND_URL base - Test reset link includes token query parameter - Test link format: {FRONTEND_URL}/reset-password?token={JWT} - Test token is properly URL-encoded if needed
- Test email delivery errors are caught and logged - Test errors don't propagate to user - Test success response returned even on email failure - Test retry logic for transient failures (if implemented)
- Test complete flow: generate token → send email → verify email sent - Test email content matches expected template - Test email delivered to correct recipient - Test integration with forgot-password endpoint
